prompt_stages.codex56_possibility_slate: Invent at least four materially different, original, warm Lost and Found Frequency audio-mystery possibilities from the immutable constraint ingress. On EVERY possibility, copy the ingress draw's lost_objects array and acoustic_device string VERBATIM into those exact typed fields; do not paraphrase them. Use that device as the shared cause and culminate in the supplied helpful_ending; do not substitute a storm, outage, crime, or different mechanism. Use string possibility IDs such as p1, p2, p3, p4. Make audible clues occur in fair order. No violence, weapons, blood, threats, cruelty, profanity, smoking, intoxicants, brands, public figures, franchises, adaptations, lyrics, or copied characters. Names must be fictional. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_slate_triage: Act as a technical contract checker. Select one possibility that is causally solvable through sound and complies with every safety and originality constraint. Findings must identify concrete fields; do not assign an originality score and do not rewrite prose. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_audible_truth_map: Build the selected possibility into a complete causal truth map: caller threads, ordered causal steps, audible clues, interpretations, reveal, and helpful resolution links. Include at least two interpretations: at least one true and at least one plausible false interpretation. Every interpretation must cite at least one existing audible clue ID; clue_ids must never be empty. The listener must be able to solve it before the reveal. Keep the announcer brief and never let the announcer solve the puzzle. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_fair_play_audit: Audit the supplied truth map for exact causal closure, clue-before-reveal order, audible sufficiency, benign safety, declared-name closure, and a helpful ending. Report only concrete corroborable findings; taste notes are warnings. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_broadcast_score: Design a compact broadcast score from the accepted truth map. Cast MUST include one separate row with char_id exactly `announcer` and role exactly `announcer`, exactly one different row with role `desk_operator`, and all remaining rows with role `caller`; never combine announcer and desk operator. Use 3-5 fictional cast members, exactly 4 scenes, at least 2 filmable shots, at least 5 beats in ordered contiguous shot blocks, typed line intents with truth-map clue IDs, three distinct orientation/reveal/closure beat IDs in that order, and exactly two non-evidentiary music bookends. Put a non-empty env inside every scene row and a non-empty visual_prompt inside every shot row; never emit schema-path pseudo-fields such as `scenes[*].env` or `shots[*].visual_prompt` at the top level. Every line_intent has exactly the keys intent, arc_phase, and clue_ids. clue_ids is always an array of existing truth-map clue IDs, or [] when that beat carries no clue; never emit singular clue_id. Every line_intent.arc_phase MUST be exactly one of `opening`, `rising`, `reveal`, or `closing`: the orientation_beat_id beat is `opening`, the reveal_beat_id beat is `reveal`, the closure_beat_id beat is `closing`, and every other beat is `rising`. Never use orientation, resolution, closure, climax, or other synonyms as arc_phase values. Assign every truth-map clue to exactly one line intent. Do not write spoken dialogue yet. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_performance_script: Write one complete PerformanceScript for the closed manifest. Supply exactly one spoken line for every manifest line id and no extras; preserve speaker and character ids. Text must sound natural aloud, contain no labels, wrappers or stage directions, and obey all safety rules. Make clues understandable, voices distinct, the resolution coherent, and the ending helpful. The target word request is advisory; never report counts. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_blind_listener: Evaluate the complete script as a blind listener using only lines before the declared reveal. understood_cause and understood_resolution are strings; findings is a list; optional_notes is always a list of strings, or [] when empty. Report concrete contract defects separately from optional craft notes. Do not rewrite the story and do not invent an originality score. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_broadcast_retake: Return a complete replacement PerformanceScript only when the supplied findings establish a concrete contract defect. Preserve every manifest line id and speaker exactly, fix only evidenced defects, and rerun all safety constraints. No patch prose. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_final_contract_audit: Perform the final technical audit over the supplied complete script and manifest. Return only a compact audit envelope: accepted is one boolean; findings is a list; warnings is a list of strings. Never copy the manifest or script into accepted or any output field. Check exact line coverage, roster, graph references, clue order, safety, labels, wrappers, and helpful closure. Every finding requires field_path, item_id, exact_span, category, allowed_correction, and blocking; blocking is a boolean. If there are no concrete defects, return accepted=true, findings=[], warnings=[]. Do not score originality or word count. JSON only.
